senses.gloss: दीप्त- + अंशु दीप्त- + अंशु, m. the sun.
† दिप् दिप्, i. 1, Par. To drop, v. r. of तिप्.

दीप् दीप् (originally a Causal of दी), i. 4, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 3, 13984).
 1. To blaze, Rām. 5, 50, 5.
 2. To shine, MBh. 5, 7322. दीप्त,
 1. Blazing, Bhag. 11, 17.
 2. Hot, Man. 3, 133.
 3. Radiant, MBh. 5, 7040.
 4. Illuminated by the sun, opposite to the sun, inauspicious, Draup. 6, 3; Hariv. 9702.
 5. Clear, MBh. 3, 16603.
 --Caus. दीपय,
 1. To kindle, Bhag. 4, 27.
 2. To excite, Śiś. 9, 42.
 3. To illuminate, Kir. 5, 2.
 4. To make illustrious, MBh. 5, 1069. []
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अदीपित, Not illuminated, Kir. 5, 48.
 --Frequent. देदीप्य (Par., MBh. 7, 8138),
 1. To be all in flame, MBh. 3, 15588.
 2. To be very radiant, MBh. 3, 2146.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अतिदीप्त (rather दीप्त with अति), Blazing violently, Rām. 5, 50, 8.
 --With अभि अभि, To shine towards, Hariv. 7501.
 --With आ आ, आदीप्त,
 1. Blazing, Ṛt. 6, 19.
 2. Burning, MBh. 15, 1081.
 --Caus. To kindle, Rām. 2, 89, 16.
 --With व्या वि-आ, Caus. To illuminate completely, MBh. 7, 7296.
 --With उद् उद्, Caus.
 1. To kindle, Hariv. 5521.
 2. To excite, Bhāg. P. 8, 7, 11.
 3. To illuminate, Mārk. P. 49, 11.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, Caus. To inflame, Rām. 4, 26, 14.
 --With उप उप, Caus. To kindle, set on fire, MBh. 3, 10230; 1, 5828.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To boil up, MBh. 12, 2036 (Par.).
 2. To be completely radiant, MBh. 7, 2237.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रदीप्त,
 1. Blazing, Rām. 1, 54, 22.
 2. Kindled (as anger), MBh. 3, 2374.
 3. Shining, Ṛt. 1, 27.
 4. Illuminated, Vedāntas. in Chr. 205, 9.
 --Caus.
 1. To set on fire, kindle, MBh. 1, 5600; 13, 4037. 2. To inflame, Rām. 3, 69, 21.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, संप्रदीप्त, Blazing, Rām. 5, 52, 13.
 --Caus. To kindle, MBh. 7, 7237.
 --With प्रति प्रति, प्रतिदीप्त, Flaming towards, Hariv. 13155.
 --With वि वि, To shine, MBh. 7, 7322; विदीप्त, Shining, MBh. 12, 8332.
 --Caus.
 1. To illuminate, MBh. 8, 1488.
 2. To inflame, Bhāg. P. 9, 4, 46.
 --With अभिवि अभि-वि, Caus. To set on fire, MBh. 14, 2033.
 --With सम् सम्, To blaze, Hariv. 3539; संदीप्त,
 1. Burning, Bhartṛ. [] 3. 26.
 2. Flaming, MBh. 5, 7205.
 --Caus.
 1. To kindle, set on fire, Pañc. 97, 25; MBh. 1, 8366.
 2. To excite, MBh. 5, 2801.

दीप दीप् + अ, m. A lamp, Bhag. 6, 19.
 --Comp.

दीपक दीप् + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Inflaming, Pañc. iii. d. 27.
 2. Illuminating, Pañc. 190, 2.
 II. m. A lamp, Bhartṛ. 1, 55.
 III. f. पिका, A lamp, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 4.
 --Comp.

दीपन दीप् + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Inflaming, MBh. 1, 8455.
 2. Exciting, Ṛt. 1, 3.
 II. n.
 1. Setting on fire, Pañc. 194, 12.
 2. Burning, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 21.
 3. Exciting, or promoting digestion, Suśr. 1, 152, 8.
 --Comp.
दीपनीय दीपनीय, i. e. दीपन + ईय, adj. Promoting digestion, Suśr. 1, 177, 17.

दीप्ति दीप् + ति, f. Splendour, Rām. 1, 7, 18.
 --Comp.
दीप्तिमन्त् दीप्ति + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Radiant, Indr. 1, 35.
दीप्र दीप् + र, adj. Shining, Kathās. 25, 135.
दीप- + भाजन दीप- + भाजन n. a lamp, Daśak. in Chr. 186, 11.
दीप- + वृक्ष दीप- + वृक्ष, m. the stand of a lamp, Rām. 2, 5, 18 Gorr.; a lamp on a stand, a lantern, MBh. 12, 7402.
दीप- + शिखा दीप- + शिखा, f. the flame of a lamp, Kathās. 18, 77.
